description: Room provider webhook handling, reconciliation and access enforcement.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online and no active room session yet.
A participant_joined event arrives with a valid member identity.
cases.inputs: event: participant_joined; roomName: "meeting-{id}"; participantIdentity: the user id; participantJoinedAt: now.
cases.return: An active session is ensured for the meeting and one open visit is recorded for the member.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online and an active room session.
A participant_joined event arrives with a valid guest identity.
cases.return: One open visit is recorded under that guest session (no user id); the session stays active.

preconditions: Meeting already Ended; its room session was closed.
A participant_joined event arrives from a ticket that outlived the meeting.
cases.inputs: event: participant_joined; roomName: "meeting-{id}"; participantIdentity: a current participant.
cases.return: The visit is still recorded as evidence, then the recreated room is deleted again and the session ended at once instead of at the next reconciliation.
cases.log: Closing {Room} again: {Identity} joined after it closed.

preconditions: Roster enforcement is on; the joiner was just removed from the participants.
A participant_joined event arrives with that member identity.
cases.inputs: event: participant_joined; roomName: "meeting-{id}"; participantIdentity: the removed member.
cases.return: The visit is recorded, then that person is taken out of the room at once instead of at the next reconciliation.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with an active session and an open visit; the leaver holds the floor of the speaking queue.
cases.inputs: event: participant_left; roomName: "meeting-{id}"; participantIdentity: the leaver.
cases.return: The open visit is closed at the event time; the closed hand is published as a Left change so the queue panels refetch (no invited target).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with an active session and two open visits.
cases.return: The session is ended at the event time and every open visit is closed with it.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; two members share their screen at once (one presenter at a time).
cases.inputs: event: track_published with trackSource ScreenShare; roomName: "meeting-{id}"; participantIdentity: the second sharer.
cases.return: Every other unmuted screen-share track in the room is muted; the second sharer keeps theirs.

preconditions: Any event arrives for a room that is not a meeting room.
cases.return: Ignored; no session or visit is touched.

preconditions: A participant_joined event arrives with an identity that is neither a user id nor a guest identity.
cases.return: Ignored; no session or visit is touched.
